source.exact_deadline_wording: apply to an English-taught degree at the University of Padova within the deadline
source.notes: The official scholarship page states there is no separate scholarship application: eligibility is conferred by the degree-course application. It gives no explicit calendar deadline for the scholarship. The operative deadline is the admission deadline of the chosen degree programme, published in that programme's Admission Notice, so there is no single deadline for this record. 'November 2026' is the stated publication month of the future Calls for Application, NOT a deadline, and was deliberately not recorded as a MONTH value. The 2026/2027 Call is the only call linked from the page; the 2027/2028 call does not yet exist on the live page.

records.title: CEU Scholarships (Central European University) — Vienna
records.deadline_display: Please make sure to check your future program's website before you start your application. ... Candidates from any country can apply for CEU financial aid. Applicants who want to be considered for these awards must apply by the appropriate deadline.

source.raw_extract: Financial aid is granted on the basis of academic merit and is available for most of our programs (only full-time programs). Please make sure to check your future program's website before you start your application. Candidates from any country can apply for CEU financial aid. Applicants who want to be considered for these awards must apply by the appropriate deadline. To be considered, indicate your interest for financial aid in the CEU Application Form ('Funding' section).
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applicants who want to be considered for these awards must apply by the appropriate deadline.
source.notes: The record's official_source_url (https://www.ceu.edu/scholarships) is dead (HTTP 404); the live official financial-aid page for the same award was used instead. That page publishes NO calendar date and explicitly defers the deadline to each degree programme. The award spans bachelor, master and doctoral levels, and the master's admissions page (https://www.ceu.edu/admissions/master, fetched) shows two financial-aid-eligible rounds with DIFFERENT dates - Round 1 'Deadline: October 15, 2026 (23:59, Central European Time)' and Round 2 'Deadline: February 2, 2027 (23:59, Central European Time)' - with 'Institutional (CEU) financial aid awards will be made in the first two rounds only', and states that some programmes 'have their own admissions calendars'. Because this record is a degree-agnostic umbrella award, selecting one of several programme/round dates would be an invention of specificity, so UNKNOWN. This is not CONFLICTING: the differing dates are different rounds/programmes, not two sources disagreeing about the same deadline. The prior catalogue value 'Typically January-February for Fall intake' is not supported by any CEU page fetched and was not carried forward.

records.deadline_display: Application Period (for current NYCU students) ■ Fall Semester: January 15-March 15 ■ Spring Semester: July 15-September 15 ＊Late application documents will not be accepted.

source.publisher: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU), Office of International Affairs
source.as_of: Page update date 2024-01-11 (page states 'Update Date：2024-01-11'); application windows stated as recurring semester periods with no year
source.raw_extract:
Application Period (for current NYCU students)
■ Fall Semester: January 15-March 15
■ Spring Semester: July 15-September 15
＊Late application documents will not be accepted. [...] Incoming students
Apply along with your admission application [...] The application period will be the same as the general application period.
source.exact_deadline_wording: ■ Fall Semester: January 15-March 15 ■ Spring Semester: July 15-September 15
source.notes: Semantics resolved as ANNUAL/recurring rather than EXACT: the provider gives day-level window boundaries (January 15-March 15 and July 15-September 15) but attaches no year, and presents them as the standing semester application period that repeats each cycle ('The application period will be the same as the general application period'). Per the brief a recurring value must never be converted into a calendar date, so deadline_date is null and no year was attached. Two further scope notes for reviewers: the windows are stated for CURRENT NYCU students only - for incoming students the page says 'Apply along with your admission application', i.e. no scholarship deadline is given; and the closing boundary is stated as the end of the window (September 15) rather than as a named 'deadline'. Page 'Update Date' is 2024-01-11, so the wording may predate the current cycle, but the same page is the live official source and no superseding notice was found.

field_mapping.deadline_display: Application Period (for current NYCU students): Fall Semester January 15-March 15; Spring Semester July 15-September 15. Late application documents will not be accepted.

source.publisher: Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service (TSLS), Ministry of Education, Government of Fiji
source.as_of: 2026-2027 Financial Year (handbook cover: 'TSLS Scholarship and Policies Handbook for the 2026-2027 Financial Year')
source.raw_extract: Step 3: Application Processing Status [...] 3. All applications must be successfully submitted before the application closing date 4. Late and incomplete applications will not be considered for assessment
source.exact_deadline_wording: All applications must be successfully submitted before the application closing date
source.notes: The scheme page (official_source_url, HTTP 200, read in full) publishes NO closing date: it gives eligibility, priority disciplines, eligible institutions and an 'Apply Now' link to apply.tsls.com.fj, and nothing else about timing. The official 2026-2027 Scholarship Policies Handbook PDF was then downloaded (36 MB, 60 pages) and its full text searched for closing/deadline wording; it states the RULE ('before the application closing date') but never states the date. A keyword sweep of all 60 pages for closing/close/deadline/last-date/must-be-submitted returned exactly this single line, so the closing date is genuinely not published in the handbook either. UNKNOWN. The only dated reference found anywhere on the official domain is a news post dated January 7, 2026 referring to 'the 31st January deadline' for the 2026 academic year - a past cycle, not scheme-specific, so it was neither written nor rolled forward. The prior catalogue precision 'recurring' is NOT supported by any source and was not carried forward.

That deadline is in the past and is not attributed to this scheme, so writing 2026-01-31 would be a stale value and inferring a 2027 equivalent from last year's pattern is exactly the cycle-assumption inference the brief forbids.
